title: Surreal Clock Landscape
description: A large circular wall clock with Roman numerals features a detailed surreal painting in its center showing a stone tower on a green rolling hill with a winding stone path. Various small symbolic objects like butterflies, a bat, pocket watch, Poké Ball, globe, and tools are arranged around the clock face.
